items.title: Global stocks edge higher as central banks signal steady rates
items.snippet: Equity benchmarks in Europe and Asia firmed in early trading after policymakers reiterated that borrowing costs would stay on hold while inflation cools.

items.title: Oil slips as supply outlook eases; dollar holds gains
items.snippet: Crude futures retreated from a three-week high as traders weighed rising inventories against steady demand, while the dollar held firm against major peers.

items.title: Show HN: I built an open-source, zero-config status dashboard
items.snippet: A weekend project that turns RSS feeds into a single static page deployed on GitHub Pages, with no backend and no API keys required.

items.title: New ARM laptop chips promise big efficiency gains for thin-and-light designs
items.snippet: The latest generation focuses on sustained performance per watt, with reference designs claiming all-day battery life under mixed workloads.

items.title: Supreme Court issues opinions in closely watched administrative-law cases
items.snippet: The decisions clarify the scope of agency authority and are expected to shape how lower courts review federal regulations going forward.

items.title: Big Law firms expand remote-first policies amid talent competition
items.snippet: Several national firms updated their flexible-work guidelines this week as associates weigh compensation against scheduling autonomy.
